principles: Lead every page with a saturated #116eee band or the violet-to-blue gradient and white 48px/900 type; keep the rest of the page white.
Make the main action a mint #11ee92 pill with dark navy text; use navy or blue pills for secondary actions, never square buttons.
Group content in soft #f3f5f8 cards with 30 to 44px corners and generous 44 to 50px padding; tint testimonial cards in cream, lilac and mint.
Keep long text in an 870px column at 16px/24px with 32px/800 headings and 24px between blocks.
Use heavy weights (800 and 900) for every heading and 700 for controls; body stays 400.
Close marketing pages with the scrolling 104px word band before the footer.
avoid: Thin or grey headings: headings are always 800 or 900 and near black or white.
Sharp corners or hairline-bordered cards on marketing pages; borders appear only on inputs and picker tiles.
Dense multi-column text; prose never runs wider than 870px.
